summary: The proof establishes the claimed uniform bound for every finite product in the stated class. The accepted cap characterization justifies the cap product inequality, including vertical cuts, and the reflection argument uses integral hitting directly. The one-dimensional hazard, tail, median, and Bhattacharyya estimates are valid, including the harmonic-mean integral bound. The exact rational certificate was independently rerun and passed all 125 HM cells and 95 B1 cells. Conditional sign cancellation, all block constants, the dyadic partition, and the sparse remainder estimate check out. Singleton supports, atoms of mass exactly one half, the eta equals one fifth boundary, finite support endpoints, empty blocks, and arbitrary dimension are covered. The resulting coefficient is at least exp(-141), which implies the asserted exp(-150) bound. No mathematical errors or gaps were found.
